summary: The Rational Speech Act model in exact rational arithmetic: the L0/S/L tower over abstract finite worlds and utterances with a Boolean lexicon; softmax rendered exactly by a nat exponent and positive cost weights (the multiplicative form of Goodman & Lassiter 2015 eq. 5); distribution theorems as iffs against decidable definedness conditions with exact failure modes (total division makes undefined distributions the zero function); L0 as conditioning; the size principle; Bayes/product/odds forms and uniqueness from proportionality; specificity orderings for any positive prior; semantic-equivalence invariance at every depth for every cost assignment (Bergen Lemmas 1-2 generalized — base RSA derives no M-implicatures); depth-n support/distribution under Bergen's restrictions; permutation well-definedness of the list encoding; the scalar implicature computed exactly (L1(w1|some)=3/4 vs 1/4; 17/18 at alpha=4; 7/8 at depth 3; L0 gives 1/2-1/2; and the preference proved symbolically for EVERY alpha>0); the GF16 faces example; Bergen's 1/4,1/6,1/8,1/10 depth table; the LG17 cookies example at alpha=4 with exact 1/6486; the symmetry problem (flat costs neutralize, size costs restore).

sources.citation: Goodman, N. & Frank, M. (2016). Pragmatic language interpretation as probabilistic inference. TiCS 20:818-829.
Frank, M. & Goodman, N. (2012). Predicting pragmatic reasoning in language games. Science 336:998 (+ Supplement).
Bergen, L., Levy, R. & Goodman, N. (2016). Pragmatic reasoning through semantic inference. Semantics & Pragmatics 9(20).
Lassiter, D. & Goodman, N. (2017). Adjectival vagueness in a Bayesian model of interpretation. Synthese 194.
Goodman, N. & Lassiter, D. (2015). Probabilistic semantics and pragmatics. Handbook of Contemporary Semantic Theory.

evidence: Every numerically load-bearing value of the sources is reproduced exactly by vm_compute (3/4, 17/18, 7/8, 1/4-1/6-1/8-1/10, 1/6486, 2/3-1/3).
The distribution theorems are honest iffs: total division makes undefined RSA distributions the zero function, and the companion _undefined theorems give the exact failure mode.
Bergen's Lemmas 1-2 are proved in generalized form (all depths, arbitrary costs) with the no-M-implicature corollary.
All 23 audited theorems closed under the global context (zero axioms, zero Parameters).
simplifications: exp/log softmax replaced by the exact nat-exponent + weight identity (header encoding lemma; irrational weights get declared rational surrogates)
B16's (o,w) collapsed to w (the paper's own move)
restrictions (i)-(ii) globalized for the depth-n theorems (flagged)
omissions: B16 lexical uncertainty (Figs. 5-6 Horn game) and the closed form 1/(2n+2): STRETCH, design has full plans T36-T41
LG17 threshold semantics on a degree grid (T42-T45)
speaker uncertainty/QUD (GF16 Box 1 III-IV), MCMC, empirical fits
additions: exact definedness conditions and failure modes (the sources never say when the model is defined)

determination_rationale: With the exact multiplicative encoding the entire MUST list is constructive and axiom-free; the only substantive translation is the softmax identity, which is GL15's own eq. (5). Two source slips surface: GF16 Box 1's cost sign (against all other sources) and LG17 eq. (20)'s printed ~.015 where the paper's own formula gives ~.00015 (= 1/6486 exactly) — both recorded, not silently corrected.

artifact_classes.description: indicator as bool+if; no utterance syntax (cost tables carry word length); B16's o=w collapse

exp/log eliminated by the nat-exponent encoding; total division makes undefinedness the zero function (hence iff-form theorems); Qred computation-essential and theory-invisible; closed claims by vm_compute
no finite sets/big operators/probability monad: lists+In, qsum, length-of-filter; list order discharged by Ln_perm_invariant
bool meanings, existsb definedness, decidable Q order; flagged stronger-than-source hypotheses: NoDup for cardinality, global coverage for depth-n

source_gap.detail: GF16 Box 1 eq. (II) prints U = log P + cost(u) where FG12/B16/LG17 subtract cost (file follows minus, discrepancy recorded); LG17 eq. (20) prints ~.015 for L1(6|SOME) but the displayed formula evaluates to 1/6486 ~ .00015 (proved exactly; fidelity note at Cookies).
